definitions.explanation: A behavioral tendency, often unconscious; can refer to good or bad habits, but frequently implies a bad or unusual habit.
Natural wave or curl in hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{癖|くせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}したい→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I want to fix my bad habit.
examples.notes: 癖を直す = to fix a habit

examples.english: I have a habit of biting my nails.
examples.notes: 〜癖がある = to have a habit of ~
口癖 = verbal habit, pet phrase

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{癖|くせ}で、⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かく→掻く：09647_kaku⟧。
examples.english: It's a habit from childhood — I scratch my head when I think.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{癖|くせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{直|なお}らない→直る：00735_naoru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: Once something becomes a habit, it's quite hard to break.
examples.notes: 癖になる = to become a habit

examples.english: My hair has a natural wave.

examples.japanese: {癖|くせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧にしたい。
examples.english: I want to straighten my curly hair.
On rainy days, the curl in my hair gets stronger.
My mother has the same wavy hair, so I think it's genetic.

examples.japanese: {癖|くせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My hair has strong curls, but lately I've been leaving it as it is.

notes:
USAGE: {癖|くせ} often has a negative connotation, referring to bad habits or peculiar behaviors. However, it can also be neutral.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {癖|くせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a habit of)
- {癖|くせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a habit)
- {癖|くせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧ (to fix a habit)
- ⟦{口癖|くちぐせ}→口癖：07281_kuchiguse⟧ (verbal habit, catchphrase)
- ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧{癖|くせ} (bad habit)
- 〜{癖|くせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (despite ~, even though ~) - a conjunctive use expressing criticism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {癖|くせ} - habit (often negative or quirky)
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ - habit, custom (neutral, established routine)
